rongmei.title: Kaipouc biak liangc nimei thow thow nai tu cho?

lines: 1 Kaipouc biak liangc nimei thow thow nai tu cho?
Bumaengh phu khang thow thow zaucgaylou ni cho?
Kandih biak ’patlouna thow rih sw nic cho?
Poubauhmei biak liangcna tat nimei thow cho?
Guangh siamruai sw nipui mei kiu thow nai cho?
Bumaengh phu guangmei khou thow ’khavlou nic cho?
Kaipouc, Nang zauzian ?|7 thuakloupui paan ?|7,
Kaipouc biak lianghmei nunc, ’niw Nang mei nunc e.
2 Hymdaihmei khang hamh e, pyrun khang hamh e,
’Niu rihmei swmei hei, rih-lu suanmei hei;
’Niu phaan theihmei pu ta ’zianpui zaeng ?|7 e;
Jisu ricmei guay ?|7 Kabiak liangh khang e.
3 He Jisu, aniw ta Nang ?|7 liulou the,
Kachaekc kaphut ?|7 hamh, Nang pumc zei ?|7 de;
Nang khou guangmei guay khou Nang suaihiam tiilou,
Kaipouc, Nang ?|7 ’niw ta tiiduaklou tuang e!
4 Rih kiu adow kunghmei, tanhmei bam nuh e,
Kum sic Guangh ric mei ta baihmei ?|7 ngam lak,
Kachuangcphey kazit bam, rih ngam puni the,
’Chumhmei ?|7 suai makna rih ngam puni de.
